answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vine of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, no identity may audit its own recruit. Each submission hangs on the basalt of a task receipt, and the marble is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
